name: Crown Towers Perth
positioning: Luxury resort hotel in Burswood on the eastern banks of the Swan River, with lagoon pools, Crown Spa and the Crystal Club
best_for: Travelers who want a resort-style pool setting in Perth
Guests who want a spa and fine dining on site

facts.text: Crown Towers Perth is located on the eastern banks of the Swan River.
The hotel's address is Great Eastern Highway, Burswood, Perth.
Guest rooms and suites feature bespoke furniture and intuitive technology.
The hotel offers villas in addition to rooms and suites.
The pool area has plush daybeds and attentive wait staff.
Fine dining options at the resort range from Nobu to Rockpool.

highlights.text: The hotel has a resort setting with expansive lagoon pools.
The hotel's resort facilities include the exclusive Crystal Club.
The hotel's resort facilities include Crown Spa.

considerations.text: The hotel is in Burswood on the eastern banks of the Swan River, not in the Perth city centre itself.
WhataHotel notes the casino-integrated environment may not suit all guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
